description: The oracle's standing questions recomputed daily (BTC/ETH/SOL vs price targets, next FOMC decision, most-traded Polymarket markets, upcoming CPI/NFP): for each, probability, 80% interval, base rate, market odds, edge and commitment hash — no waiting, no LLM call, cached. Pass slug to get one forecast with full drivers/failure modes and its history. Poll in a loop for cheap calibrated priors. $0.002/call. Use for today's standing forecasts without waiting; to ask your own question use oracle_forecast.

slug.description: Optional board slug, e.g. btc-120k-oct31. Omit for the whole board.
